verdict.rationale: Fellow's marketing documents bot-free recording that captures audio directly from the desktop across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack Huddles and in-person meetings. Its recordings produce full diarized, timestamped transcripts. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how the desktop capture mode works (setup, supported OS, consent handling), an explicit statement that external participants see no indicator, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the bot-free mode.
